wholePhysicalScope: Four native corners of the standing roof envelope. Original hall, verandas and entrance subdivided using the 1908 view and heritage register 600032.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the raised hall, steep gables and veranda. Close views resolve the exposed studs, posts, sash windows and rear stair.
limitations: Paint colors are estimates from the documented timber and galvanized iron materials. The archival photo is monochrome.
Veranda subdivisions, eastern stair, rear openings and foundation levels are approximate. The current cafe interior and fittings are outside the exterior scope.
